source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.3, printed page 234.

blocks.text: Maadde (matter) ke saath saath tawanai (energy) bhi be-jaan mahol aur jandaron ke darmiyan behti hai. Lekin maadde ke chakkar (cycling) ke bar-aks tawanai ka behao sirf ek simt mein (unidirectional) hota hai; tawanai wapas nahin lautti.

blocks.prompt: Ecosystem mein tawanai ka behao nutrients (ghizai ajza) ki harkat se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Nutrients zinda aur be-jaan hisson ke darmiyan chakkar lagate hain aur dobara istemal hote hain, jabke tawanai sirf ek simt mein behti hai: dhoop ban kar aati hai aur aakhir kaar garmi (heat) ban kar nikal jati hai.

items: Maadda chakkar lagata hai; tawanai ek simt mein behti hai (unidirectional).
